svg.title: 06 · Network & security
svg.desc: CloudFront with WAF and the Transfer Family SFTP endpoint are the only public entries; every task runs in private subnets of a two-zone VPC, reaches AWS services through VPC endpoints, and leaves only through NAT and Network Firewall to Cognito.
svg.text: PRIVATE SUBNETS · AZ A + AZ B
Two public entries. No task has a public IP.
